question: By whose grace does the speaker come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
Knowledge arises by that lord's grace.
What becomes known is the determination of the Kaula teaching.
inference: By the grace of the lord of the Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the Kaula determination.
uncertainties: The prior state of ignorance is not detailed.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
